title: Post town added for UK recipient addresses in the Get Order Detail API
breadcrumb: Post town added for UK recipient addresses in the Get Order Detail API
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2025-07-10
html:
Summary

Addresses in the United Kingdom (UK) require a Post Town, so we've added a data field for UK buyers to include their Post Town information.

What's changed?

To support this, we've added a new property post_town to the recipient_addresses object in the Get Order Detail API.

Which markets are affected?

This change affects the UK market only.

Who is affected?

Developers with applications that use the Get Order Detail API to manage orders for sellers are affected.

What action is required?

Applications that include an integration with the Get Order Detail API should be updated to include support for post_town field in the recipient_addresses object.
